description: Single-file Minesweeper: three difficulties plus custom size/mine count, guaranteed-safe first click, flood-fill reveal, flags and question marks, chording, timer, mine counter, win detection, localStorage best times per difficulty.

criteria: minesweeper_model_01.html is one self-contained Minesweeper (no libraries): beginner/intermediate/expert presets plus a custom dialog, mine placement that guarantees the first click never hits a mine, left-click reveal with recursive flood-fill of empty regions, right-click flag cycle, middle-click or both-button chording, an accurate mine counter and centisecond timer, win/lose detection with reveal of all mines and wrongly flagged cells, and best-time persistence per difficulty in localStorage. No precomputed or lucky boards.
